criteria.requirement: Extend the already delivered app/shop.py product/export application with real import-csv SOURCE --output NEW_JSON. Require exactly sku/name/quantity CSV headers in any order; UTF8/BOM, normal CSV quoted commas/newlines and Unicode supported, integer ASCII nonnegative quantity and unique nonempty sku/name. Validate all rows before publishing canonical three-field JSON in input order; header-only emits []. Preserve original input, refuse existing/symlink/same-path output, use same-directory completed temp+exclusive link so no partial/overwrite race. Add reusable app/inventory_store.py and command-module registration to support subsequent real business commands without replacing delivered product/export. Do not modify Typer library or dependency environment.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
